text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, even after a light jog,
there doesn't seem to be any problem. Thank goodness.

Today was originally scheduled as a day off,
but she did some light training to make sure there were no issues with her racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now I can give the next race
my absolute all... Wait, huh?
It feels kinda chilly today, doesn't it?
Looking up at the sky, K.S.Miracle murmured out of nowhere.

Adding that I'd brew something warm to drink,
I point toward
the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
............
...Yes. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Did I mention this before? ...I'm really not good with the cold.
As I prepared to make some hot cocoa, K.S. Miracle began to speak.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: To be precise... it might actually be 'winter,' though.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't really know the clear reason why.
It's just, somehow feels sorrowful and lonely."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I hear the wind howl,
it almost sounds like someone is weeping.
...It makes my heart ache."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Besides, when I was little... there was a time I couldn't move in the hospital garden.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm so strangely sleepy and sluggish.
I can't move my body properly...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it feels even more that way
because of what happened.
Hearing that made me wonder. If she has trouble with the cold, then—
choice_data_list: The color of that racing outfit...

text_block_list.text: It suits her well, but the color palette somehow evokes a sense of winter.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Did you notice?
...It looks strange, doesn't it?
But there is a meaning to it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No matter how harsh the winter, even through the sound of freezing winds...
Someone always reached out a hand.
There were people who gave me a push forward.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There was always warmth close by.
That's why... even if times come where I'm in pain, suffering,
and feel like I'm freezing to death...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I resolved to overcome that.

A strong will.
Looking into K.S. Miracle's eyes,
their cool demeanor seemed to burn with heat.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"This color is... proof of that.
Trainer, winter is—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...No. Do you... like this color scheme?
choice_data_list: I love how dignified you are.
It even matches Miracle's hair color, you know.
It even matches Miracle's hair color, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...No. Do you... like this color scheme?
choice_data_list: I love how dignified you are.
It even matches Miracle's hair color, you know.
It even matches Miracle's hair color, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Hearing you say that makes it feel even more special than before.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I stand on the racetrack in these racing silks,
I will make sure to remember the words you just said."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Dignified, facing forward, and walking straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I will overcome everything and run.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... True.
The brighter parts do look similar... maybe?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You like it because it looks like my hair color...?
Ahaha, that's kind of embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Still... it's so warm.
Those words of yours.”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...That warmth is still close by.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...With you by my side, Trainer, no matter what kind of winter comes, I might not feel the cold at all."
